Enabled.Name: Copy Between Environments
Enabled.Description: Copy selected objects and Task dependencies between configured MOVEit environments. Requires both MOVEit and MAUI administrator access and Data Access credentials for both environments.

RecoveryRetentionDays.Name: Copy recovery retention
RecoveryRetentionDays.Description: Days to retain operation reports and protected overwrite recovery definitions (1–90).

Enabled.Name: Keep Alive Service
Enabled.Description: When enabled - this service keeps the app pool alive by pinging an endpoint on the server at a set interval. This is necessary to allow scheduled jobs to run when the app pool might otherwise be cold.

UseMauiSystemSettingsEditor.Name: Use MAUI Settings Editor
UseMauiSystemSettingsEditor.Description: Edit MOVEit Settings and manage lockouts with MAUI. Disable to use the MOVEit native editor.

UseMauiTaskEditor.Name: Use MAUI Task Editor
UseMauiTaskEditor.Description: Open Traditional, Advanced and Synchronization Tasks in the experimental MAUI Task Editor. When disabled, Task links use the native MOVEit Task Editor.

UseMauiHostEditor.Name: Use MAUI Host Editor
UseMauiHostEditor.Description: Open Hosts in the experimental MAUI Host Editor. When disabled, Host links use the native MOVEit Host Editor.

UseMauiScriptEditor.Name: Use MAUI Script Editor
UseMauiScriptEditor.Description: Create and edit custom PowerShell and VBScript Scripts in MAUI. Disable to use the native MOVEit editor. The built-in Script editor is read-only; administrators can maintain MAUI properties through Script Information.

UseMauiDateListEditor.Name: Use MAUI Date List Editor
UseMauiDateListEditor.Description: Create and edit Date Lists in the experimental MAUI Date List Editor. When disabled, Date List links use the native MOVEit editor.

UseMauiGroupsAndPermissionsEditor.Name: Use MAUI Group & Permissions Editor
UseMauiGroupsAndPermissionsEditor.Description: Manage Resource Groups, membership and assigned user-group permissions with MAUI. Disable to use the native MOVEit editor.

RequestTimeoutSeconds.Name: REST Request Timeout Seconds
RequestTimeoutSeconds.Description: Maximum time allowed for ordinary MOVEit REST requests. Host tests and Browse allow at least 5 minutes, extended by native timeout/retry settings up to 30 minutes.

IdleSessionTimeoutMinutes.Name: Idle Session Timeout
IdleSessionTimeoutMinutes.Description: How long MAUI keeps a signed-in session active without user activity.

AllowInvalidServerCertificates.Name: Allow Invalid Server Certificates
AllowInvalidServerCertificates.Description: Development-only option that allows REST connections to Web Admin servers using an untrusted TLS certificate.

TaskRunHistoryMaxCount.Name: Task Run History Maximum
TaskRunHistoryMaxCount.Description: Maximum Task Run records requested when determining each Task's latest status.

Provider.Name: Database Provider
Provider.Description: Database provider used for UI-only metadata and hierarchy information.

ConnectionString.Name: Connection String
ConnectionString.Description: Connection string for the selected MAUI metadata database provider. SQLite relative paths are resolved from the MAUI application folder; absolute paths are also supported. SQL authentication credentials, when used, are stored in this value.

Enabled.Name: Enable Automatic Backup of MAUI and MOVEit Configuration Data
Enabled.Description: When enabled, MAUI automatically backs up the MOVEit Automation configuration, appsettings.json, and the MAUI SQLite metadata database when SQLite is configured.

FrequencyHours.Name: Backup Frequency
FrequencyHours.Description: How often MAUI creates an automatic configuration backup.

RetentionDays.Name: Backup Retention
RetentionDays.Description: How many days MAUI backup folders are retained before the Backup Cleanup System Job removes them.

RetentionDays.Name: Log Retention
RetentionDays.Description: Number of days MAUI retains application log events in the metadata database before automatic cleanup.

RetentionDays.Name: Job History Retention
RetentionDays.Description: Number of days MAUI retains execution history for scheduled jobs, including individual Report run history.

Enabled.Name: Display System Message
Enabled.Description: Displays the configured System Message banner on authenticated MAUI pages.

MessageType.Name: Message Type
MessageType.Description: Controls the icon and visual severity of the System Message banner.

MessageBody.Name: Message Body
MessageBody.Description: Plain-text message displayed to authenticated MAUI users.

Enabled.Name: Enable Recycle Bin
Enabled.Description: When enabled, MAUI attempts to save deleted Tasks, Hosts, custom Scripts, and Date Lists so they can be restored later.

RetentionDays.Name: Recycle Bin Retention
RetentionDays.Description: Number of days deleted items remain available in the MAUI Recycle Bin before automatic cleanup.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Task Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age of cached Task data for non-forced reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Task Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Task grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

Encryption.Name: Default Encryption Algorithms
Encryption.Description: Ordered default encryption algorithms for new SFTP Hosts and the Host editor Reset action.

KeyExchange.Name: Default KEX Algorithms
KeyExchange.Description: Ordered default key exchange algorithms for new SFTP Hosts and the Host editor Reset action.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Host Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age of cached Host data for non-forced reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Host Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Host grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Script Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age, in seconds, of cached Script data used by non-forced backend reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh while the cache entry remains in memory; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Script Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Script grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Date List Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age of cached Date List data for non-forced reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Date List Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Date List grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Global Parameter Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age of cached Global Parameter data for non-forced reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Global Parameter Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Global Parameter grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

CacheRefreshSeconds.Name: Keys and Certificates Cache Refresh Seconds
CacheRefreshSeconds.Description: Maximum age of cached Keys and Certificates data for non-forced reads. Set to 0 to disable age-based refresh; Refresh Now still forces a live read.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Keys and Certificates Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Seconds between automatic Keys and Certificates grid refresh requests while the page is visible. Requests honor the backend cache age; set to 0 to disable automatic refresh.

BatchResultLimit.Name: Limit single batch result entries to
BatchResultLimit.Description: Maximum Task Run rows retrieved for one batch. Higher limits can significantly reduce page and grid performance.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Task Run Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Number of seconds between live Task Run grid refreshes while the page is visible. Set to 0 to disable automatic UI refresh.

BatchResultLimit.Name: Limit single batch result entries to
BatchResultLimit.Description: Maximum File Activity rows retrieved for one batch. Higher limits can significantly reduce page and grid performance.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI File Activity Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Number of seconds between live File Activity grid refreshes while the page is visible. Set to 0 to disable automatic UI refresh.

BatchResultLimit.Name: Limit single batch result entries to
BatchResultLimit.Description: Maximum Audit rows retrieved for one batch. Higher limits can significantly reduce page and grid performance.

UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Name: UI Audit Refresh Interval
UiRefreshIntervalSeconds.Description: Number of seconds between live Audit grid refreshes while the page is visible. Set to 0 to disable automatic UI refresh.

FitColumnsToGrid.Name: Fit Columns to Grid
FitColumnsToGrid.Description: When enabled, unused horizontal grid space is assigned to the last visible column so the visible columns fill the grid width without creating horizontal overflow.

HighlightFailedTasksInGrid.Name: Highlight Failed Tasks in Grid
HighlightFailedTasksInGrid.Description: When enabled, failed Task rows are highlighted in red when the Status column is visible.

DefaultRowSize.Name: Default Row Size
DefaultRowSize.Description: Default number of rows displayed per page before a user saves a personal Grid Page Size preference.

SelectRowsBeyondGridSize.Name: Select Rows Beyond Grid Size
SelectRowsBeyondGridSize.Description: When enabled, the grid header checkbox selects all rows matching the current filters, including rows beyond the current page. When disabled, it selects only rows visible on the current page.

Theme.Name: Default User Theme
Theme.Description: Default theme used when a user has not saved a personal preference.

StartPage.Name: Default User Start Page
StartPage.Description: Default landing page used when a user has not saved a personal preference.

TaskJsonEditor.Name: Task JSON Editor
TaskJsonEditor.Description: Edit individual Task JSON values or replace matching values across selected Tasks. Review changes before saving. Existing Task edit permissions and checkout safeguards apply.

CheckoutObjectsForDurationOfEdit.Name: Checkout Objects for Duration of Edit
CheckoutObjectsForDurationOfEdit.Description: Reserve objects while their MAUI editor is open to prevent concurrent edits. Checkout is released when the editor closes or its editing session expires.

AutoFormatNewTaskHostNames.Name: Auto Format New Task/Host Names
AutoFormatNewTaskHostNames.Description: Controls if the Auto Format Name option is enabled by default for Tasks and Hosts.

EnableQuickTransfer.Name: Enable Quick Transfer
EnableQuickTransfer.Description: Allow MOVEit administrators to access Transfers > Quick Transfer. When disabled, navigation is hidden and direct requests are blocked.

ImportRowLimit.Name: Import Row Limit
ImportRowLimit.Description: Maximum number of CSV/Excel Task rows displayed per page and imported per batch (1-1000).

TaskFailureAlertsEnabled.Name: Task Failure Alerts
TaskFailureAlertsEnabled.Description: Displays a temporary System Message with an audible alert when one or more MOVEit Task runs fail.
